stories.headline: Nepal warns of possible fresh flooding as communities grapple with devastation
stories.note: Authorities warned of renewed flooding as rising river levels and a newly formed high-mountain lake kept downstream communities on alert.

stories.headline: How the Lake Ontario / “Lake America” name change will appear in Maps
stories.note: The same lake now appears under different official names depending on where a map user stands, turning cartography into geopolitics.

currentWorks.note: Lawrence provides these works to students free of charge when they arrive on campus. Students reading before arrival should use the editions listed here.

items.title: Death and Life of the Great Lakes
items.creator: Dan Egan
items.invitation: Treat the inland seas as an engineered ecosystem and contested commons: commerce, invasive species, policy, repair, and the question of who gets to govern water.

image.alt: Cover of The Death and Life of the Great Lakes by Dan Egan

items.title: Flood narratives
items.creator: Gilgamesh and Noah
items.invitation: Set these ancient floods beside Yu and other water traditions: who is warned, what is saved, and what theory of order emerges after the water?

image.alt: The cuneiform Flood Tablet from the Epic of Gilgamesh

items.title: Selection of music in the Delta Blues tradition
items.creator: Various musical artists
items.invitation: Hear the Mississippi not as scenery but as land, labor, migration, dispossession, love, and loss—made audible in the Delta blues.

image.alt: Portrait of Delta blues singer and guitarist Mississippi Fred McDowell

items.title: Blood Dazzler
items.creator: Patricia Smith
items.invitation: Enter Katrina through shifting voices—including the storm itself—and confront racialized abandonment, failed infrastructure, and what poetry can witness that news cannot.

image.alt: Cover of Blood Dazzler by Patricia Smith

items.title: The Interesting Narrative
items.creator: Olaudah Equiano
items.invitation: Cross an Atlantic made into a route for capital and forced migration in an autobiography, maritime adventure, and insurgent argument for abolition.

image.alt: Oxford World's Classics cover of The Interesting Narrative by Olaudah Equiano

items.title: Rising: New Dispatches from the American Shore
items.creator: Elizabeth Rush
items.invitation: Meet communities living with rising seas and ask who receives protection, who is told to retreat, and whose loss becomes acceptable policy.

image.alt: Cover of Rising by Elizabeth Rush
